Power: The number of action dice the player rolls for the creature when it attacks.

Defense: The amount of damage it takes to disrupt a creature (remove it from its current space on the board).

Locations: Locations have a spawn cost and an aspect cost (just like creatures), but no power, defense or life.  They cannot move, but offer some special ability to the rest of the warband.

Aspects: Most miniatures belong to one of the four aspects of Valor, Fear, Madness, and Passion. The Anvilborn are mechanical in nature, and thus are not driven by the aspects (which are essentially 'feelings'). Each aspect has different qualities which are reflected as basic traits in the miniatures; for example creatures from the Madness aspect primarily have low Defense but high Life.

Lineages: Some miniatures belong to a lineage.  Lineages are creatures spawned by a specific dream lord or a group of dream lords. There are six lineages: Bloodcut, Janus, Lost, Hellbred, Hiveling, and Stitched.

Abilities: The initial Dreamblade rulebook lists approximately 50 different miniature abilities.  Blade abilities are the most common of these.

Blade Abilities: Blade abilities come in four types (blade, double blade, multiblade, and double multiblade), each representing the number of blades (a special symbol which may be rolled on the dice) which may be spent on the ability: one, two, unlimited, or an unlimited even number respectively.  All rolled blades must be spent, which allows for the existence of blade abilities which have negative effects.

Spawn abilities: Spawn abilities are like blade abilities except that they are activated in the spawn phase by paying spawn points and sometimes may only be activated when in specific cells on the board.

Come into Play abilities: Come into play (CiP) abilities activate whenever the miniature is spawned, usually as an extra cost to playing the piece or as a special ability.

Drive abilities: Drive abilities are specific to Anvilborn creatures, from the third booster set. Each Anvilborn creature moves not by regular movement, but by being driven, which determines how it moves at the beginning of the Spawn phase.

Playing area: The playing area is a five by five grid.  Players start out on opposite corners of the grid (this is known as the player's portal).  The back row is known as the spawning row, and the center 3×3 grid is known as the key cells.

Spawning Row: The row closest to a player is his or her Spawning Row; after the first round, players may spawn creatures in a cell in their spawning row that shares a column with another creature the player controls and is unoccupied.

Key Cells: All of the cells within this 3×3 grid are worth conquest points to one or both of the players.  The row closest to a player's spawning row is worth five, four or three conquest points to his opponent, starting with the cell corner adjacent to the player's portal.  The center square of the middle row is worth two points to either player, while the other two cells are worth one point each.  If a cell is contested (both players have creatures in the cell) then neither player receives any conquest points.

Attack Dice: Attack dice are six-sided (see the attached picture).  Two of their faces count as misses (diamonds), three of the faces count as damage, with a one-point, two point, and three point damage face.  The final face is the dreamblade, which is used to power the special abilities of the miniatures in the game; unlike other games, these abilities are not optional – any blades rolled on a turn must be used if possible.

Tournament play was a large part of Dreamblade. Wizards of the Coast held Duelists' Convocation International-sanctioned Dreamblade tournaments all over the world.

Constructed - Each player brings their premade warband of miniatures to the event. A warband must have no more than 16 miniatures and players may not use more than 3 of the same miniature.

Sealed Box - Players make a warband out of the miniatures they received from booster packs given out to each player as part of the tournament. If using three boosters, the warbands must have no more than 16 miniatures, as in constructed play. If using two boosters, the warbands must have no more than 12 miniatures, and once during the game at the start of the turn a player may take the miniatures in their graveyard and put them back in their reserves. (This is called the "refresh" rule.)

Booster Draft - Players assemble in groups, ideally consisting of 4 players each. Each group is called a "pod". Within each pod, boosters are opened one at a time, and players draft a single miniature from that booster, before passing the remainder to the next player in turn. This format can be done with either two or three boosters, and the maximum warband size requirements and "refresh" rule for two-booster format are the same as with Sealed Box.

Edge - These were events held at local stores, and offered promotional alternate-paint miniatures as prizes.

1K - These were larger tournaments where the total prize awarded was $1000. The 1st-place winner received $500, 2nd place received $300, and 3rd and 4th places received $100 each.

10K - These were much larger international events where the total prize awarded was $10,000. The 1st-place winner earned $2000.

Championship - This event, which required qualification through earning enough points at other events, offered $50,000 in total prizes. The 1st-place winner earned $10,000.  On August 19, 2007, at Gen Con, Ben Stoll won the only "Dream Series Championship" ever held.

Wizards of the Coast no longer supports these programs, though independent tournament organizers may still sanction non-premier Dreamblade tournaments.

Base Set was released on August 9, 2006, and consists of 96 miniatures, divided as 32 of each rarity, and 24 of each Aspect.

Baxar's War, released on October 27, 2006, was the first expansion for Dreamblade and consists of 60 miniatures: 20 of each rarity, 15 of each Aspect. New abilities introduced by this expansion include Poison and Terrify. A new lineage was also introduced for the Madness and Fear Aspects, called The Stitched.

Chrysotic Plague, released on January 19, 2007, was the second expansion for Dreamblade and consists of 60 miniatures: 20 of each rarity, 15 of each Aspect. New abilities introduced by this expansion include Deathform and Shapechange. The Fear Aspect lineage Hivelings was also expanded with this release.

Anvilborn, the third Dreamblade expansion was released on April 20, 2007. This expansion consists of 60 miniatures: 20 of each rarity, 13 of each Aspect, 8 'neutral' Anvilborn (all Rare or Uncommon).

Night Fusion, the fourth and final Dreamblade expansion was released on September 7, 2007. This expansion consists of 60 miniatures: 20 of each rarity, 12 of each Aspect, and 12 multi-Aspect. New mechanics in this set include Dream Lords and Shield abilities.

Serrated Dawn, the fifth Dreamblade expansion which was canceled prior to production. On December 4, 2007, Wizards of the Coast released the stats for the pieces that would have been in Serrated Dawn.

The song is frequently played live, most recently as a combination with Queen's "We Will Rock You" during the first chorus. It is the only song from See You on the Other Side that has remained a staple of their live set. It has also been performed several times on television, including Jimmy Kimmel Live! and Spike TV's Scream Awards.

The video was directed by Little X, his second time behind the lens for a rock band. The video begins with Korn performing in a desert in broad daylight. The sky begins to shatter like glass during the chorus to reveal a night sky. Later, the whole background shatters, leaving a plain white background. Lastly, they literally become undone while continuing to perform, and as they do, they resemble slinkies. The band is completely unraveled and gone by the ending of the video.

Former Detroit Tigers third baseman Brandon Inge used the song as his walkup song when batting. It was also used as the walkup song for Hunter Pence when he played for the Philadelphia Phillies. It was also featured in a commercial for the CBS crime drama series Criminal Minds and in the video games Blitz: The League and The Bigs 2. An instrumental version is used for the TNA wrestler Frankie Kazarian, also known as Kaz. It also appeared in VH1's "100 Most Shocking Music Moments" in the discussion of the Woodstock 1999; both "Did My Time" and "Coming Undone" are heard in the background.

Korn and Atlanta crunk rappers Dem Franchize Boyz did a mash-up of their respective hit singles at the time, "Coming Undone" and "Lean wit It, Rock wit It", titled "Coming Undone wit It". It was produced by Jermaine Dupri and Scott Spock from The Matrix, and was first released on AOL in April 2006. A video for "Coming Undone wit It" was released on the DVD portion of Chopped, Screwed, Live and Unglued. This is the official remix to both songs.

Various elements of the two songs were combined with new parts exclusive to the mashup, produced by Scott Spock of The Matrix.

=== RECORD UNDER REVIEW ===
Subject: Matter file

Hello Felix,

Procedure:
1. The current version of the forms used in this process is published on the intranet.
2. A scanned copy of the contract may be accepted before the original is requested.
3. All correspondence about the matter file is copied to the Collections shared mailbox.
4. Personal data is viewed and shared only to the extent the task requires.
5. The manager reviews the list of open matter files every week and adds notes where needed.
6. When on leave, the manager delegates authority to a deputy in writing.
7. Before any matter file is closed, all attachments are checked for legibility.
8. Collections owns this procedure and approves any changes to it.
9. Every change to the record is logged with the name of the user who made it.
10. If the formal notice is missing, the record is put on hold and the requester is informed.
11. Abbreviations are not used in records; explanations are written as full sentences.
12. Handovers between External Counsel and Collections are documented with a handover form.
13. Customer communications are written in plain language using the corporate template.
14. Legal Counsel must answer process questions within 10 business days.
15. The formal notice is scanned and archived by Legal Counsel within 2 business days.
16. Requests received by phone are converted into a written record on the same day.
17. The approval chain is cumulative by amount — up to $2,000,000: unit manager; above $2,000,000 up to $3,500,000: unit manager + department head; above $3,500,000: unit manager + department head + deputy general manager.
18. Internal audit samples records from this process once a year.
19. During a system outage, actions are logged on a manual sheet and entered later.

The External Counsel manager could not attend the weekly review. Two new staff members started induction this week. An automatic acknowledgement was sent to the record owner. Olivia Murphy said they liked the new screen layout. The menu order on the department's phone line was changed. A new briefing session is planned for Collections staff. Olivia King shared, as an example, that a similar file last year ended with 'deputy general manager'. The large-font option was used on the record screen. The team reorganised the shared folder.

The record details are below:
Record ID → IHT-79162
Claim amount → $2,943,009
Approvals so far → department head (Ruby Bennett, approved)

Call notes were entered into the system shortly afterwards. Samuel Thomas mentioned that a colleague might ask a similar question. The team lead has just returned from annual leave. Because of the rain, the face-to-face meeting was held online. Olivia Hall said no further explanation was needed. Ruby Hughes thanked the team at the end of the call. The record was created during business hours. Grace Green used their corporate e-mail address in the exchange. Due to an office move, some files were temporarily moved to another floor. Ethan Wilson said the information text was easy to understand.

Kind regards.

Ekip lideri yıllık izinden yeni döndü. İl Müdürlüğü personeli için yeni bir bilgilendirme toplantısı planlanıyor. Ece Çetin bilgilendirme metnini anlaşılır bulduğunu söyledi. Müşteriye gönderilen bilgilendirmeler sade bir dille ve kurum şablonu kullanılarak hazırlanır. Barış Yılmaz, bir meslektaşının da benzer bir soru sorabileceğini söyledi. Bu süreçte kullanılan formların güncel sürümü kurum içi portalda yayımlanır. Sevgi Erdem görüşme sonunda ilgili ekibe teşekkür etti. Ekipte iki yeni çalışan oryantasyona başladı. Telefonla alınan talepler aynı gün içinde yazılı kayda dönüştürülür. Hava yağmurlu olduğu için yüz yüze görüşme çevrim içi yapıldı. Yönetici her hafta açık destek başvurusu listesini gözden geçirir ve gerekirse not ekler. Ekim beyannamesi eksikse kayıt beklemeye alınır ve talep sahibine bilgi verilir. Kayıt, mesai saatleri içinde oluşturuldu. Aynı konuda açılmış birden fazla kayıt varsa en eski kayıt ana kayıt olarak kullanılır. Kayıt sahibine otomatik bir alındı bildirimi gönderildi. Tapu/kira sözleşmesi aslı istenmeden önce taranmış kopyası kabul edilebilir. Kontrol Birimi yöneticisi haftalık değerlendirmeye katılamadı. Bu prosedürün sahibi İl Müdürlüğü olup değişiklikler onun onayıyla yürürlüğe girer. İç denetim, bu süreçten yılda bir kez örnek kayıt seçerek inceleme yapar. Kayıt üzerinde yapılan her değişiklik, değişikliği yapan kullanıcının adıyla günlüğe yazılır. Kerem Şahin, yeni ekran tasarımını beğendiğini belirtti. Kayıtlarda kısaltma kullanılmaz; açıklamalar tam cümle olarak yazılır. Sistem duyuruları ana sayfada güncellendi. Destek başvurusu kapatılmadan önce tüm ekler okunabilirlik açısından kontrol edilir. Destek başvurusu ile ilgili tüm yazışmalar Kontrol Birimi ortak kutusuna kopyalanır. Süreçle ilgili eğitimler yılda en az bir kez tekrarlanır. Hülya Aslan yazışmada kurumsal e-posta adresini kullandı. Görüşme notları sisteme kısa süre içinde girildi. Otomatik sistem, izinli olduğu günlerde yetkisini yazılı olarak bir vekile devreder. Sistem kesintisi durumunda işlemler elle tutulan çizelgeye yazılır ve sonra sisteme aktarılır. Çiftçi kayıt belgesi, Kontrol Birimi tarafından 10 iş günü içinde sisteme taranarak arşivlenir. Ofisteki toplantı odası bakım nedeniyle bu hafta kullanılamıyor. Kontrol Birimi ile İlçe Tarım Müdürlüğü arasındaki devirler devir formu ile belgelenir. Ekip, ortak klasörün düzenini yeniledi. Ofis taşınması nedeniyle bazı dosyalar geçici olarak başka kata alındı. Kayıt ekranında yazı tipi büyütme seçeneği kullanıldı.

states.69cbfb5c3d0d:
Konu: Dosya listesi

Merhaba Fatma,

Ekip, ortak klasörün düzenini yeniledi. Kayıt sahibine otomatik bir alındı bildirimi gönderildi. Aynı konuda açılmış birden fazla kayıt varsa en eski kayıt ana kayıt olarak kullanılır. Kerem Aydın ek açıklama yapmaya gerek görmediğini belirtti. Müşteriye gönderilen bilgilendirmeler sade bir dille ve kurum şablonu kullanılarak hazırlanır. Telefonla alınan talepler aynı gün içinde yazılı kayda dönüştürülür. Bölümün telefon santralinde menü sırası değiştirildi. Tahsilat ile Dış Avukatlık Bürosu arasındaki devirler devir formu ile belgelenir. Yönetici, izinli olduğu günlerde yetkisini yazılı olarak bir vekile devreder. Kayıtlarda kısaltma kullanılmaz; açıklamalar tam cümle olarak yazılır. Dosya kapatılmadan önce tüm ekler okunabilirlik açısından kontrol edilir. Ofis taşınması nedeniyle bazı dosyalar geçici olarak başka kata alındı. Seda Yılmaz, bir meslektaşının da benzer bir soru sorabileceğini söyledi. Sistem duyuruları ana sayfada güncellendi. Dış Avukatlık Bürosu personeli için yeni bir bilgilendirme toplantısı planlanıyor. Dosya ile ilgili tüm yazışmalar Dış Avukatlık Bürosu ortak kutusuna kopyalanır. Kayıt, mesai saatleri içinde oluşturuldu. Ekipte iki yeni çalışan oryantasyona başladı.

İlgili kayıt bilgileri aşağıdadır:

Kayıt no: IHT-8978 / Durum: kapandı / Tebliğden bu yana geçen gün: 46 gün
Kayıt no: IHT-7205 / Durum: uzlaşmada / Tebliğden bu yana geçen gün: 43 gün
Kayıt no: IHT-6848 / Durum: açık / Tebliğden bu yana geçen gün: 55 gün
Kayıt no: IHT-3789 / Durum: süre bekleniyor / Tebliğden bu yana geçen gün: 59 gün
Kayıt no: IHT-6127 / Durum: uzlaşmada / Tebliğden bu yana geçen gün: 52 gün

İhtarname eksikse kayıt beklemeye alınır ve talep sahibine bilgi verilir. Dış Avukatlık Bürosu, süreçle ilgili soruları 7 iş günü içinde yanıtlamakla yükümlüdür. Ekip lideri yıllık izinden yeni döndü. Sistem kesintisi durumunda işlemler elle tutulan çizelgeye yazılır ve sonra sisteme aktarılır. Tolga Kılıç yazışmada kurumsal e-posta adresini kullandı. Kayıt ekranında yazı tipi büyütme seçeneği kullanıldı. İç denetim, bu süreçten yılda bir kez örnek kayıt seçerek inceleme yapar. Hava yağmurlu olduğu için yüz yüze görüşme çevrim içi yapıldı. Nazlı Özdemir, yeni ekran tasarımını beğendiğini belirtti. Kişisel veriler yalnız işin gerektirdiği ölçüde görüntülenir ve paylaşılır. Talep eden kişi her hafta açık dosya listesini gözden geçirir ve gerekirse not ekler. Bu prosedürün sahibi Dış Avukatlık Bürosu olup değişiklikler onun onayıyla yürürlüğe girer. Fatura, Dış Avukatlık Bürosu tarafından 5 iş günü içinde sisteme taranarak arşivlenir. Gül Ekinci görüşme sonunda ilgili ekibe teşekkür etti. Pınar Arslan bilgilendirme metnini anlaşılır bulduğunu söyledi. Süreçle ilgili eğitimler yılda en az bir kez tekrarlanır. Ofisteki toplantı odası bakım nedeniyle bu hafta kullanılamıyor. Kayıt üzerinde yapılan her değişiklik, değişikliği yapan kullanıcının adıyla günlüğe yazılır.

İyi çalışmalar.
